Details
Kavak Offer Updates and Weekend Staffing: Jaqueline Sanches stated that they received information from Kavak regarding vacation time and will rearrange offers to send back by November 2nd. Additionally, Jaqueline Sanches and Armando Flores discussed evaluating part-time or full-time staffing options for weekends and festive days, with Jaqueline Sanches planning to consult David, the labor lawyer, regarding this matter.

Kavak Christmas Party Logistics: Armando Flores announced that the Kavak Christmas party is scheduled for December 1st in Mexico City, with Mexico-based employees invited. Armando Flores mentioned that they must pay approximately $1,000 in merchandise for raffles, while travel expenses for attendees are not covered by the company. The team also discussed operational details, cultural norms around open bars and large company celebrations in Mexico compared to other regions, and potential future events.

IMSS Registrations and Address Updates: Cristhian Herrera and Jaqueline Sanches discussed the status of employee registrations and address updates handled by Abraham through Outend. Cristhian Herrera noted that the final step is validation with the IMSS (referred to as IMS), which Abraham was expected to complete. Jaqueline Sanches highlighted that once the address is set, Abraham must perform retroactive registrations for unregistered employees, with Armando Flores available to step in physically next week if online processing fails.

Fiscal Address and Contract for Kavak Office: Juliana Turin and Armando Flores addressed the fiscal address and office measurements involving a facilities contact and hub leader. Juliana Turin noted that a lawyer was drafting the corresponding contract, while Armando Flores pointed out the challenges of obtaining exact geolocation and perimeter data, agreeing that reference points would be provided to update the draft.

CAM Contract Negotiations and Tax ID Updates: Cristhian Herrera reported on CAM contract negotiations, noting that legal teams reviewed the proposal while raising concerns regarding the IMSS scheme due to recurring portal and registration issues. Meanwhile, Juliana Turin stated that Santiago indicated the new address must be updated in their tax ID (SAT) to process payments for active drivers, which Armando Flores confirmed was updated by Abraham.

Ramp Integration and Travel Platform Evaluation: Cristhian Herrera stated that they are negotiating integrations with Ramp via API to reduce manual work and handle VAT deductions and expenses for both US and Mexico entities. In parallel, Armando Flores and Cristhian Herrera reviewed Mendel for travel management, concluding that Mendel functions as a corporate travel platform unsuitable for drivers because it requires creating individual user profiles for every trip, leading the team to prioritize the Ramp integration instead.

Aging Dashboard Development: Cristhian Herrera provided an update on the aging dashboard, stating that Moa completed the tool and that Marcel and Cristhian Herrera will conduct internal testing before rolling out the report for client and country tracking no later than the following week.

Fleet Management RFP Win and Closing Updates: Armando Flores announced that they won the RFP with a major fleet management company in Mexico, which is expected to cover 10 percent of next year's growth and yield a 35 to 37 percent gross margin. Depending on the awarded percentage, they may need to hire an additional staff member or set up an implant under facilities. Additionally, Jaqueline Sanches and Cristhian Herrera coordinated to ensure Abraham completes employee registrations the following day.
